params.q: Which coaching institute did A R Rajah Mohaideen, UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 7, study at?

response.reconstructed_markdown:
A R Rajah Mohaideen \(UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 7\) utilized guidance and mentorship from a few key institutions rather than a single full\-time traditional coaching setup: [0]

- Residential Coaching Academy \(RCA\), Jamia Millia Islamia: He was a resident student at Jamia Millia Islamia's RCA, which provided him with a structured residential environment and support for his preparation. [1]
- Vajiram & Ravi: He utilized their open mock tests for the prelims phase and participated in their Vajiram & Ravi Interview Guidance Programme. [2] [3]
- Legacy IAS Academy: He also engaged with Legacy IAS Academy in Bengaluru for mentorship and interview guidance/mock interviews. [0]
- Self\-Study: For his core preparation \(particularly overcoming his earlier prelims attempts\), he relied heavily on a self\-study approach focusing on basic standard books, solving previous year questions \(PYQs\) extensively, and single\-source revision rather than relying on full\-length foundational classroom coaching. [2]

Would you like to know more about his anthropology optional strategy or his prelims preparation roadmap?
